issues.detail: The Greek 'μη νεοφυτον' (not a new convert/novice) is rendered as 'chớ lập người mới tin' (do not appoint/establish a new believer), which adds the action of 'appointing' which is not in the source text. The source is a prohibition against a specific status, not an action.
The term 'tự kiêu' (proud/arrogant) is added in the Vietnamese translation; the Greek text only mentions 'typhōtheis' (being blinded/becoming blind).
